title: Boundary contract (O) — v1.0
description: plan.md §2/§5. One per crates/*/specs/_boundaries/<caller_concept>_<caller_method>__to__<callee_concept>_<callee_method>.json. Prototype A scope: role safety only (G2+) -- no assurance-target field yet, that lands with the I-schema (M3).

boundary_id.description: Must equal the filename stem exactly (G1b, enforced separately by scripts/validate_boundary_naming.py).

callee_guarantees.description: Callee POSTCONDITION/INVARIANT relied on (docs/reliance-policy.md resolution rule). Never a callee precondition (-> bridge spec instead) and never an adversary case (-> evidence only, G2+ rejects it here).

items.description: <Concept>.<id>, e.g. TaskQueue.C003. Deliberately permissive at the schema layer (accepts the C-obligation shape and the A-adversary shape alike) -- G1a checks structure only. Whether the id names a real obligation, belongs to the right concept, and isn't an adversary case is G2+'s job (role safety), not this schema's -- see scripts/validate_boundary_contracts.py.

concept.description: PascalCase, matches the concept-to-code 'concept' field convention.
